data.app_name: The Pirate Queen with Lucy Liu
data.description:
Embark on an epic journey through the turbulent waters of history in "The Pirate Queen", with Lucy Liu 🌟

![{"height":224,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-sin11-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38982662_7513468888773292_7586277367396825871_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=z7aS7LcV4DsQ7kNvgHALeih&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-sin11-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYCnnIKyGqzigx5P2YJ3RFJFZHXon6_0ssMzYgL3UCIeUA&oe=6718DE9C)

Step into the boots of the legendary pirate Cheng Shih and see if you have what it takes to become history's most powerful pirate  🏴‍☠️


![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-sin6-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39036653_1456869748359051_7076517034930849202_n.png?_nc_cat=111&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=NCuhz5A5SOMQ7kNvgG5m0Bn&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-sin6-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYCc0CLAQx0VE2A5DxbkgSqa8yhTZ0mJTLXQS8ESAuGIEA&oe=6718E824)


Travel back in time with this immersive story, perfect for explorers of all ages. Whether you're seeking a fresh adventure, yearning to escape into another world, or eager to unearth a hidden gem from history, this legend is for you.

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-sin6-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39003263_961033948683270_8273646164126363713_n.png?_nc_cat=111&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=VjXY0gH62NIQ7kNvgHjc7WT&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-sin6-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYC-32U9JLFBIL3FuoIuiV7cFtomCjswAD5VbGBcr0ni3A&oe=6718CF87)

With light gameplay elements, the focus is on the narrative. Dive into a story-rich experience lasting 1-4 hours ⏳, climb rigging, explore moonlit cabins 🌙, unearth hidden artefacts, and exercise your wit to become leader of the Red Flag Fleet.  

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-sin6-4.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39031579_801519894943640_3850714342256227051_n.png?_nc_cat=100&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=lrZ0Dn1_LOIQ7kNvgGK-bws&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-sin6-4.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYDBxj7dcpme6WHsQRQrZ-fZbTpxjiLs2dceTZj_PWmquA&oe=6718C266)

![{"height":231,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-sin11-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39031400_1653444588750690_8451663376835143463_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=df5qaqAqBIMQ7kNvgHjY4Iy&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-sin11-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYBVbrTs-GTJLFylpWCLPH3mwJkZLf2dyJiAX2FWr5i3cQ&oe=6718EED8)

Celebrated for its cinematic story and historical environments, this non-combat experience has earned critical acclaim, winning the Tribeca Storyscapes Award (2023) & the Raindance Discovery Award (2021) 🏆

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-sin6-3.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75322595_315227141608157_6664541123259039926_n.png?_nc_cat=104&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=1xZIt32vqOMQ7kNvgFJ5vWj&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-sin6-3.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYAKm8faDk-920SdcW012c3w8KzshxtUndL9SoSB_6INbA&oe=6718EB59)


![{"height":225,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-sin6-3.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38974820_419365674368364_6471370540204954427_n.png?_nc_cat=106&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=v6fDAQjG32kQ7kNvgGr6I9B&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-sin6-3.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYDP4Jz6wDnTWJi-eLdcl_felAqv5WTdPsZ2urCRrbkYgw&oe=6718D170)

Experience the captivating performance from Hollywood actress Lucy Liu 🎭, who brings Cheng Shih's character to life, under the direction of critically acclaimed filmmaker and creative director Eloise Singer 🎬


![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-sin6-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/57569455_779145490949371_5639970595016054333_n.png?_nc_cat=102&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=Ly6kakmYK6YQ7kNvgHQMje6&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-sin6-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYDzCUq6OHlEc9pwHwpfmT2qH9eMOSwvpuRV-Pt3g0Lf1g&oe=6718F42A)

![{"height":244,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-sin6-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75593949_1392764491611640_7662168618929982906_n.png?_nc_cat=108&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=TEkEXjXXC40Q7kNvgGC5MWa&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-sin6-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYALRPB4cMdBwzxOo63fXTVDbB464p-ktqInrXhCaKkBpg&oe=6718CF97)

Are you ready to turn the tides of history? Let's see how well you fare as The Pirate Queen! 🏴‍☠️👑



![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-sin11-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75251817_478868781249664_4666816330504461518_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=YKx-hcC0urEQ7kNvgGEzI_I&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-sin11-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYAdxlWnm5sa_lURjqr0pRchXDPdhYRF8PHMMw84zY0FHQ&oe=6718EB0C)
